data.name: Great Carbon Valley
data.description: Great Carbon Valley (GCV) is a Kenyan project development venture and systems integrator founded in 2023 by Bilha Ndirangu and James Irungu Mwangi, aiming to build DAC+storage industrial hubs in the Great Rift Valley by combining geothermal power, basalt mineralization storage, land, and DAC technology partners. GCV has signed agreements with Climeworks, Sirona Technologies, Yama, AspiraDAC, Cella, and Beyond Captur, with a first DAC+S facility targeted for 2028. Its vision is to capture at least 1 million tonnes of CO2 annually by 2030.
